verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized account dashboard that acts as a centralized hub for updates and documents. Received registered-agent mail is scanned and uploaded to the account's cloud storage, and business licenses can be uploaded, viewed and shared through the account. Nothing in the evidence shows managing a portfolio of multiple entities and their state registrations in one account, or team or multi-user access with roles. missing for 10: multi-entity portfolio management, centralized view of state registrations across entities, team/multi-user seats and permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access
